**DAILY BRIEFING — June 10, 2026**

Yesterday was a complete rest day with 6765 steps and reasonable calorie burn at 2388 kcal. Your stress sat low at 28/100, which is excellent, but that 6.3 hours of sleep fell short of optimal recovery needs. Your body was clearly seeking more restoration time.

Your HRV dropped to 99ms, sitting just below your baseline range of 100-117ms — a clear signal that recovery isn't complete. However, your resting heart rate remains solid at 46 bpm, and your training stress balance shows you're in good form territory at -2. You're not overtrained, just slightly under-recovered.

Given the suppressed HRV and shorter sleep, dial back any planned intensity today. If you have an easy run scheduled, keep it truly conversational and consider cutting it 10-15% shorter. This is Phase 1 — your body's adaptation signals matter more than hitting exact numbers right now. Trust the process.

Karl, this is exactly why we monitor these metrics. Your body is teaching you to listen, and that skill will be gold come Chester Marathon day. Recovery days aren't lost days — they're investment days. Stay patient with the aerobic build. Champions are made in moments like this.
